### `r paste0(toupper(watershed), " watershed with ", toupper(model), " and version ", medfateland_version)`

#### Goodness-of-fit

```{r, echo = FALSE}
Q_daily_cal <- Q_daily |>
  dplyr::filter(Date >= options$calibration_start,
         Date <= options$calibration_end)
Q_daily_eval <- Q_daily |>
  dplyr::filter(Date > options$calibration_end)
Q_monthly_cal <- Q_monthly |>
  dplyr::filter(Date >= options$calibration_start,
         Date <= options$calibration_end)
Q_monthly_eval <- Q_monthly |>
  dplyr::filter(Date > options$calibration_end)
```


```{r, echo = FALSE}
# Daily NSE
nse_daily_cal<-hydroGOF::NSE(Q_daily_cal$Qcal,Q_daily_cal$Qobs,na.rm=TRUE)
nse_daily_eval<-hydroGOF::NSE(Q_daily_eval$Qcal,Q_daily_eval$Qobs,na.rm=TRUE)

# Monthly NSE
nse_monthly_cal<-hydroGOF::NSE(Q_monthly_cal$Qcal,Q_monthly_cal$Qobs,na.rm=TRUE)
nse_monthly_eval<-hydroGOF::NSE(Q_monthly_eval$Qcal,Q_monthly_eval$Qobs,na.rm=TRUE)

# Daily KGE
KGE_daily_cal<-hydroGOF::KGE(Q_daily_cal$Qcal,Q_daily_cal$Qobs, s=c(1,1,1), na.rm=TRUE, method=c("2021"), 
                             out.type=c("full"), fun=NULL, 
                             epsilon.type=c("none"), 
                             epsilon.value=NA)
KGE_daily_eval<-hydroGOF::KGE(Q_daily_eval$Qcal,Q_daily_eval$Qobs, s=c(1,1,1), na.rm=TRUE, method=c("2021"), 
                             out.type=c("full"), fun=NULL, 
                             epsilon.type=c("none"), 
                             epsilon.value=NA)

# Monthly KGE
KGE_monthly_cal<-hydroGOF::KGE(Q_monthly_cal$Qcal,Q_monthly_cal$Qobs, s=c(1,1,1), na.rm=TRUE, method=c("2021"), 
                             out.type=c("full"), fun=NULL, 
                             epsilon.type=c("none"), 
                             epsilon.value=NA)
KGE_monthly_eval<-hydroGOF::KGE(Q_monthly_eval$Qcal,Q_monthly_eval$Qobs, s=c(1,1,1), na.rm=TRUE, method=c("2021"), 
                             out.type=c("full"), fun=NULL, 
                             epsilon.type=c("none"), 
                             epsilon.value=NA)

# Index of agreement
d_daily_cal<-hydroGOF::dr(Q_daily_cal$Qcal,Q_daily_cal$Qobs, na.rm = TRUE)
d_daily_eval<-hydroGOF::dr(Q_daily_eval$Qcal,Q_daily_eval$Qobs, na.rm = TRUE)

d_monthly_cal<-hydroGOF::dr(Q_monthly_cal$Qcal,Q_monthly_cal$Qobs, na.rm = TRUE)
d_monthly_eval<-hydroGOF::dr(Q_monthly_eval$Qcal,Q_monthly_eval$Qobs, na.rm = TRUE)

# Volumetric efficiency
ve_daily_cal<-hydroGOF::VE(Q_daily_cal$Qcal,Q_daily_cal$Qobs, na.rm=TRUE, fun=NULL,
                       epsilon.type=c("none"), epsilon.value=NA)
ve_daily_eval<-hydroGOF::VE(Q_daily_eval$Qcal,Q_daily_eval$Qobs, na.rm=TRUE, fun=NULL,
                       epsilon.type=c("none"), epsilon.value=NA)

ve_monthly_cal<-hydroGOF::VE(Q_monthly_cal$Qcal,Q_monthly_cal$Qobs, na.rm=TRUE, fun=NULL,
                       epsilon.type=c("none"), epsilon.value=NA)
ve_monthly_eval<-hydroGOF::VE(Q_monthly_eval$Qcal,Q_monthly_eval$Qobs, na.rm=TRUE, fun=NULL,
                       epsilon.type=c("none"), epsilon.value=NA)

# RMSE
rmse_daily_cal<-hydroGOF::rmse(Q_daily_cal$Qcal,Q_daily_cal$Qobs, na.rm=TRUE, fun=NULL,
                       epsilon.type=c("none"), epsilon.value=NA)
rmse_daily_eval<-hydroGOF::rmse(Q_daily_eval$Qcal,Q_daily_eval$Qobs, na.rm=TRUE, fun=NULL,
                       epsilon.type=c("none"), epsilon.value=NA)
rmse_monthly_cal<-hydroGOF::rmse(Q_monthly_cal$Qcal,Q_monthly_cal$Qobs, na.rm=TRUE, fun=NULL,
                       epsilon.type=c("none"), epsilon.value=NA)
rmse_monthly_eval<-hydroGOF::rmse(Q_monthly_eval$Qcal,Q_monthly_eval$Qobs, na.rm=TRUE, fun=NULL,
                       epsilon.type=c("none"), epsilon.value=NA)
```



```{r, echo = FALSE}

validation_coefficients<- data.frame(Scale = c("Daily", "Daily", "Monthly", "Monthly"),
                                     Period =  c("Calibration","Evaluation","Calibration","Evaluation"),
                                     NSE = NA,
                                     KGE = NA,
                                     d = NA,
                                     VE = NA,
                                     RMSE = NA)

validation_coefficients$NSE[1]<-round(nse_daily_cal,3)
validation_coefficients$NSE[2]<-round(nse_daily_eval,3)
validation_coefficients$NSE[3]<-round(nse_monthly_cal,3)
validation_coefficients$NSE[4]<-round(nse_monthly_eval,3)

validation_coefficients$KGE[1]<-round(KGE_daily_cal[["KGE.value"]],3)
validation_coefficients$KGE[2]<-round(KGE_daily_eval[["KGE.value"]],3)
validation_coefficients$KGE[3]<-round(KGE_monthly_cal[["KGE.value"]],3)
validation_coefficients$KGE[4]<-round(KGE_monthly_eval[["KGE.value"]],3)

validation_coefficients$d[1]<-round(d_daily_cal,3)
validation_coefficients$d[2]<-round(d_daily_eval,3)
validation_coefficients$d[3]<-round(d_monthly_cal,3)
validation_coefficients$d[4]<-round(d_monthly_eval,3)

validation_coefficients$VE[1]<-round(ve_daily_cal,3)
validation_coefficients$VE[2]<-round(ve_daily_eval,3)
validation_coefficients$VE[3]<-round(ve_monthly_cal,3)
validation_coefficients$VE[4]<-round(ve_monthly_eval,3)

validation_coefficients$RMSE[1]<-round(rmse_daily_cal,3)
validation_coefficients$RMSE[2]<-round(rmse_daily_eval,3)
validation_coefficients$RMSE[3]<-round(rmse_monthly_cal,3)
validation_coefficients$RMSE[4]<-round(rmse_monthly_eval,3)

validation_coefficients |> 
  kbl() |>
  kable_styling()
```

#### Time series

*Daily*

```{r, echo = FALSE, fig = TRUE, fig.width=8, fig.height = 3, warning=FALSE}
ggplot(Q_daily |>
         dplyr::select(-Qunc) |>
         dplyr::rename(Observed = Qobs,
                       Predicted = Qcal) |>
         tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c("Observed", "Predicted"), names_to = "type", values_to = "Q") 
       , aes(x=Date))+
  geom_line(aes(y = Q, col = type), linewidth = 0.5, alpha = 0.8)+
  geom_vline(xintercept = as.Date(options$calibration_end), col = "darkgray", linetype = "dashed")+
  scale_y_continuous("Q (m3/s)")+
  scale_color_discrete(NULL, palette = c("black", "lightblue"))+
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position = c(0.1,0.85), legend.background = element_blank())
```

*Monthly*


#### Hydrological analysis (daily scale)

*Density distribution*

```{r, echo = FALSE, fig = TRUE, fig.width=8, fig.height = 3, warning=FALSE}
g1<-ggplot(Q_daily_cal) +
  geom_density(aes(x=Qobs), col="black") +
  geom_density(aes(x=Qcal), col="lightblue")+
  scale_x_continuous("Daily Q (m3/s)", transform = "log10")+
  labs(subtitle = "Calibration period")+
  theme_bw()
g2<-ggplot(Q_daily_eval) +
  geom_density(aes(x=Qobs), col="black") +
  geom_density(aes(x=Qcal), col="lightblue")+
  scale_x_continuous("Daily Q (m3/s)", transform = "log10")+
  labs(subtitle = "Evaluation period")+
  theme_bw()
cowplot::plot_grid(g1, g2, ncol = 2)
```

*Percentiles*

```{r, echo = FALSE}
p = c(0.01,0.05,0.10,0.15,0.25,0.50,0.75,0.85,0.90,0.95, 0.99)
perc_df <- data.frame("Observed/Calibration" = quantile(Q_daily_cal$Qobs, probs = p, na.rm=TRUE),
                      "Simulated/Calibration" = round(quantile(Q_daily_cal$Qcal, probs = p, na.rm=TRUE),3),
                      "Observed/Evaluation" = quantile(Q_daily_eval$Qobs, probs = p, na.rm=TRUE),
                      "Simulated/Evaluation" = round(quantile(Q_daily_eval$Qcal, probs = p, na.rm=TRUE),3))
perc_df |> 
  kbl() |>
  kable_styling()
```
